recipes.label: Match headers and footers to template
recipes.summary: Gives every document your template's headers and footers, with each document's own section number and title filled in.

recipes.label: Remove headers and footers
recipes.summary: Removes the headers, the footers or both from every section.

recipes.label: Add or remove a watermark
recipes.summary: Draws your words faintly behind every page, or takes a watermark out.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Watermark words
fields.help: Exactly as they should appear; one line.

recipes.label: Swap the logo
recipes.summary: Replaces the logo in the headers with a picture you attach, fitted to the same space.

fields.name: old
fields.label: Old logo
fields.help: Attach the old logo too to swap only that picture.

recipes.label: Match body formatting to template
recipes.summary: Gives each document your template's outline styles and numbering, its page, its font, and lets the styles set paragraph spacing, indents and alignment. Words, tables, headers and footers stay as they are.

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Your template's style for each part of a section
fields.help: Read from your template; change any that is wrong.

fields.name: clear
fields.label: Let the styles set paragraph spacing, indents and alignment
fields.help: Clears those three where a paragraph sets its own. Bold, italic and underlined words stay.

recipes.label: Match font to template
recipes.summary: Sets the text in your template's body font and size; headings, notes and other sizes keep theirs.

recipes.label: Change font
recipes.summary: Sets the text in the font and size you choose, no template needed; headings, notes and other sizes keep theirs.

fields.name: font
fields.label: Font
fields.help: The font's name exactly as Word lists it.

fields.name: size
fields.label: Size
fields.help: Only text in each document's own body size changes size; headings, notes and other sizes keep theirs.

recipes.label: Page size and margins
recipes.summary: Sets the paper size and the four margins on every section of every document.

fields.name: paper
fields.label: Paper
fields.help: A paper size is set upright: a document with landscape pages is left untouched, with the reason.

fields.name: header_footer
fields.label: Header and footer distance from the page edge (in)
fields.help: Leave it empty to keep each document's own.

recipes.label: Find and replace
recipes.summary: Replaces words you list with your replacements in the body, headers and footers.

fields.name: table
fields.label: Or a table of pairs (first column: find; second: replace)

fields.name: whole_word
fields.label: Whole words only
fields.help: On: “NFPA 13” leaves “NFPA 13R” alone.

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Change the issue stamp
recipes.summary: Finds the issue stamp wherever it sits, on the cover, in a header or in a footer, and replaces every one with your new wording.

fields.name: current
fields.label: The stamp as it reads now
fields.help: Each wording exactly as it reads; any of them is replaced.

fields.name: text
fields.label: The new stamp
fields.help: Exactly as it should appear; one line.

fields.name: allow_missing
fields.label: Leave a document without the stamp as it is
fields.help: Off: such a document waits under Left untouched, with the reason.

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Add END OF SECTION where missing
recipes.summary: Ends every document with your closing line and its own section number, and corrects one that reads otherwise.

fields.name: text
fields.label: The line
fields.help: It starts with END OF SECTION; {number} is each document's own section number, from its SECTION line, and appears once.

options.label: Like the SECTION line at the top

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Keep numbers with their units
recipes.summary: Puts non-breaking spaces in “150 psi” and “21 13 13” so Word never splits them across two lines; no words change.

fields.name: units
fields.label: Units
fields.help: Unit symbols separated by commas, such as psi, gpm, ft, in or °F.

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Accept or reject all tracked changes
recipes.summary: Accepts every pending tracked change, so the copies are clean, or rejects every one.

fields.name: action
fields.label: Every tracked change
fields.help: Reject: insertions go, deletions come back, moves and formatting changes are undone.

recipes.label: Remove all comments
recipes.summary: Removes every comment and its replies.

recipes.label: Remove highlighting
recipes.summary: Removes Word's highlighter colour from all text.

recipes.label: Remove hidden text
recipes.summary: Removes text Word hides with its Hidden font setting.

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Remove empty paragraphs
recipes.summary: Removes blank lines from the body.

options.label: Keep one where several stand together

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Clean up spaces
recipes.summary: Turns two or more spaces in a row into one and removes spaces at the end of a line; tabs stay.

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Standardize quotes and dashes
recipes.summary: Makes every quotation mark straight or curly, turns “--” into a dash, and writes section numbers one way.

fields.name: section_separator
fields.label: Between the parts of a section number

fields.name: tracked
fields.label: Show my changes as tracked changes in Word
fields.help: Off: clean copies. On: each change is a tracked change a reviewer can accept or reject.

recipes.label: Remove hyperlinks
recipes.summary: Takes the links off web and e-mail addresses; the words stay and look like the text around them.

options.label: Links to a place in the document (a table of contents)

recipes.label: Freeze fields as plain text
recipes.summary: Turns fields into the text they show now, so dates and cross-references stop changing; page numbers are never frozen.

recipes.label: Remove unused styles
recipes.summary: Deletes the styles nothing in the document uses, so the Styles pane lists only what is in use.

fields.name: keep
fields.label: Styles to keep (optional)
fields.help: Style names separated by commas; these stay even when unused.

recipes.label: Name files by section number and title
recipes.summary: Names each edited copy from its own section number and title.

recipes.label: Set the document title property
recipes.summary: Sets File → Info → Title from each document's own section number and title.

fields.name: pattern
fields.label: Title
fields.help: {number} and {title} stand for each document's own; the other words are yours.

recipes.label: Turn off Track Changes
recipes.summary: The copies open with Word's Track Changes setting off.

recipes.label: Save clean PDFs
recipes.summary: Saves a PDF of every document with its comments removed and its tracked changes accepted; your Word documents stay as they are.

recipes.label: Set author and company
recipes.summary: Sets File → Info → Author, Company and Subject to your words, or clears the author names before issue.

fields.name: clear_authors
fields.label: Clear the author names (Author and Last Modified By)
fields.help: Tracked changes and comments keep their authors' names.

recipes.label: Set proofing language
recipes.summary: Sets the language Word checks spelling and grammar in; no text changes.

fields.name: only
fields.label: Change

options.label: Only other kinds of English to this one

fields.help: Only other kinds of English: French or Spanish quotations keep their language.
